question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

My brother became very __frail__ after his long sickness.
solution:
The correct answer is option no. (1) i.e. **'Strong'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** Frail **means (of a person) weak and delicate.**(कमजोर / भंगुर)**

 
 
• **Example:- **She is very weak and** frail **at the moment.
 
 
 
• The word **Strong** means having the power to move heavy weights or perform other physically demanding tasks.**(मजबूत)**
 
 
• **Example:- **She must be very** strong **to carry such a weight on her back.
 
 
 
• As both the words** frail and strong **are opposite in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no. **(1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Other options are**:

 
 
• **Violent- **using or involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.**(उग्र)**
 
• **Feeble- **lacking in physical or mental strength.**(कमजोर)**
 
• **Docile- **ready to accept control or instruction; submissive.**(सहजता से मान जाने वाला)**
